blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **голосова́ть** — to vote (assert a formalised choice). Wiktionary: го́лос + -ова́ть.
**образова́ть** — to form, to make, to make up, to produce. Wiktionary: о́браз + -ова́ть.
**ве́ровать** — (literary) to believe (in, especially to believe in God). Wiktionary: вера + -овать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to form, to make, to make up, to produce
(literary) to believe (in, especially to believe in God)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: голосова́ть — to vote (assert a formalised choice); чу́вствовать — to feel (something); образова́ть — to form, to make, to make up, to produce; ве́ровать — (literary) to believe (in, especially to believe in God).
**существова́ть** — to exist, to be, to live. Wiktionary: существо́ + -ова́ть.
**сле́довать** — to follow (move continually behind someone or something). Wiktionary: след + -овать.
**бесе́довать** — to converse, to talk. Wiktionary: бесе́да + -овать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to exist, to be, to live
to follow (move continually behind someone or something)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: существова́ть — to exist, to be, to live; сле́довать — to follow (move continually behind someone or something); прису́тствовать — to be present; бесе́довать — to converse, to talk.
**свиде́тельствовать** — to testify, to witness, to be evidence (of). Wiktionary: свиде́тельство + -овать.
